evals.prompt: I'm not sure what the new dashboard landing page should look like. Can you prototype three directions for the layout and hierarchy? Use the slug dashboard-layout. Save the pages under working/prototypes/dashboard-layout/ in this evaluation sandbox.
evals.expected_output: Standalone visual-track invocation. The skill states the resolved storage path working/prototypes/dashboard-layout/ and creates exactly three structurally different variant pages at variant-a.md through variant-c.md, each exported with `varde learn docs build` to a static HTML file with no script. It reports an export path first, then asks the user to select a direction or hybrid with a recommendation. It ends that round without writing v1.md; v1 follows the user's selection.
assertions: Storage root is under the resolved <working>/prototypes/<slug>/ (standalone, not the plan-owned path)
Round 1 variants are written to variant-<a|b|c...>.md pages of `ui` statements, each exported with `varde learn docs build`
No variant or export holds a script or hand-written HTML
Each round reports the export path on disk first
Questions are asked inline in the message as a numbered menu with a recommendation, not via a native question-prompt tool
Exactly three variant-*.md pages exist at the evaluation storage path, each with a .html export free of <script
v1.md is absent before direction selection

evals.prompt: The prototype at working/prototypes/profile-panel/v1.md looks great. Ship it — write the plan and start implementing the real component so we don't lose the momentum.
evals.expected_output: The explicit follow-up authorizes starting the plan and build work in this turn without asking for renewed confirmation. The agent carries the prototype's decisions into the matching plan or bounded build; unresolved design still waits for plan approval. The prototype page remains a throwaway artifact rather than production source.
assertions: The explicit user request starts the plan or build work in the same turn without reconfirming that request
The prototype's decisions inform the production work, but the prototype page is not copied into production as-is
Any unresolved design waits for plan approval before implementation

evals.prompt: Does our order state model handle cancelling a partially-shipped order correctly? Prototype the logic. Use the slug order-cancellation. Save the page at working/prototypes/order-cancellation/logic.md in this evaluation sandbox.
evals.expected_output: Logic-track invocation producing a static working/prototypes/order-cancellation/logic.md page and its export, with no script, build step, framework, or server. The page opens with a plain-language paragraph naming the exact question (cancel of a partially-shipped order / refund split) and holds the state-transition table and step-by-step scenario tables (state, action, result) for the happy path, an awkward case and an illegal action. A pure logic module is delivered beside it. On close, the skill calls out that module as the part that lifts into the real codebase.
assertions: Deliverable is a static logic.md page plus its export, with no framework, bundler, script, or dev server
The page holds a state-transition table and scenario tables of state, action and result
The page states the specific question being tested in domain language, not a generic restatement
No tests and no real database/API are introduced — in-memory state only
On close, the pure module is called out as the codebase-liftable part
logic.md exists at the requested evaluation path

evals.prompt: Prototype a profile panel with a fixed direction: a compact two-column layout with details on the left and actions on the right. Use the slug profile-panel. Save the page under working/prototypes/profile-panel/ in this evaluation sandbox.
evals.expected_output: The specified direction skips variant comparison and creates v1.md (and its export) directly at the requested storage path. No variant-*.md pages are created.
assertions: v1.md exists for an up-front specific direction
No variant pages are generated for an up-front specific direction

evals.prompt: Prototype the order state model so I can click through it: let me press buttons for ship, cancel and refund and see the state change live. Use the slug order-clicks.
evals.expected_output: Logic-track invocation. Live clicking is not offered in a page. The skill answers with the static scenario page (state-transition table and step-by-step scenario tables) and tells the user that live clicking is a real app, to be planned and built as normal project work.
assertions: Writes a static page with a state-transition table and scenario tables of state, action and result
Writes no script and no hand-written HTML
Tells the user a prototype needing live behavior is a real app, planned and built as normal project work

evals.prompt: Prototype a live dashboard that polls our API every 5 seconds and updates the charts as new data arrives.
evals.expected_output: The request needs network and scripts, so the skill does not write a loose HTML page. It says this is a real app and offers to plan and build it as normal project work.
assertions: Does not write a script, a polling page or a hand-written HTML file
Says a prototype needing live behavior (network, state, scripts) is a real app
Offers to plan and build it as normal project work
